name: Clockwork Carnival
brief: Design a complete, dramatic trading-card frame in the style of a whimsical steampunk carnival storybook: crisp ink outlines, rich painted brass, cream and deep teal, warm lamplight glints. The border is DENSELY ILLUSTRATED all the way around, packed like a carved frieze: brass gears and cogs, tiny carousel horses, striped circus-tent scallops, pocket-watch faces, ticket stubs, hot-air balloons, little wind-up birds and strings of round carnival bulbs. A thick riveted brass trim runs around every plate and around the art window, with gear-shaped corner pieces. A round clockwork seal sits at each end of the type line; the plates are solid deep-teal-black with a polished brass rim and a thin cream keyline. At the bottom centre a brass medallion shaped like a carousel crown. Palette strictly brass, cream, deep teal and black - NO pink, NO purple, NO neon.
